text_block_list.text: So, goodbye.

"It was a blue ocean. The ground underfoot 
was soft, and the scent of the tide hung 
in the air all around."

Someone I don't know is waving goodbye 
with reluctance. As I watched blankly, she 
turned back toward the other side—toward 
the sea.

I felt an overwhelming urge to stop them. 
Yet no words came out. My legs wouldn't 
move, nor could I raise my arms.
Please... remember... okay?

The sound of the waves grows louder. Her 
voice is drowned out completely.

My vision blurs, fading to white, and 
before long, everything vanishes—

It was early afternoon in the Trainer's 
office.

I hastily sat up. Apparently, I had been 
dreaming. As soon as that realization set 
in, the memory slipped away like water.

I feel like I was trying to hold someone 
back as they walked away.

However, just who was that...? The more I 
tried to think about it, the foggier it 
became, until I couldn't remember at all.

Thinking there was no use obsessing over a 
dream, I opened my laptop and booted up my 
daily blog. However—

After confirming that other sites were 
accessible, I tilted my head in confusion. 
Then, a thought struck me.
choice_data_list:
Why did you start a blog in the first 
place...?

text_block_list.text:
I set it up so naturally, but... why in 
the world did I even do this in the first 
place?

I feel like I'm letting something slip 
through my fingers. But I don't even know 
what it is.

Looking outside, the sky was completely 
clear. I opened the window to calm my 
mind. —And then.
(Whoosh...!)

A sudden gust of wind blew in. Books, 
handouts, and plushies on the desk tumbled 
down one after another.

I hastily closed the window and began 
picking up the fallen items. The doll I 
picked up last was unexpectedly heavy—
That is the safest and most secure way.
I thought I suddenly heard a voice.

A scene slowly surfaces in the back of my 
mind. There's a sound. I strained my ears 
desperately, trying to reel in the thread.

Before long, it turned into—a vivid, 
roaring cheer.

An Umamusume sprinting across the turf. 
Desperately churning up the dirt, turning 
again and again, her speed increases with 
every blink.
Taaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

And as she crossed the finish line more 
brilliantly than anyone else—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan is here!
I stood up instinctively.

Why had I forgotten? The girl I saw in my 
dream was Aston Machan. The blog is a 
daily routine for Aston Machan's sake.

I had an overwhelmingly bad feeling. I 
tried to get in touch, but the call 
wouldn't go throughâ

Unable to just sit around, I went to go 
see Aston Machan. However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who looks like this doll? 
Hmm, I feel like I might have seen one 
before, but...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
I feel like she looks like that girl 
playing with a cat the other day... No, 
maybe it's someone else.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: Nope, haven't seen 'em.
Aston Machan was nowhere to be found.

Her favorite spots, scenery she might 
like— I desperately rack my memories. 
Where else could she have gone—

I don't know why I thought that. Yet, I 
had a strange certainty.
She stood all alone by the night sea.

Whatever she was trying to do... In any 
case, I rush over to her immediately.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...No, but it doesn't matter. This is as 
far as Chan-Me goes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I did think it was rather strange.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I just couldn't get along with spring, 
even more than usual. And the sound of the 
waves felt so close, so very close..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I was called. I simply walked, and 
arrived."
Aston Machan quietly gazed at the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little early, ...but it 
can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone flows from upstream to 
downstream. After all, that is only 
natural.

I have no idea what she's talking about. 
And yet, she's definitely making a 
momentous decision right now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So, goodbye.

Aston Machan turned on her heel. âI have 
to stop her. That was my only thought.
choice_data_list:
What about getting revenge in the 
"Sprinters Stakes"?

text_block_list.text:
"You vowed at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival, didn't you? That you'd leave an 
unforgettable impression in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...It's a shame, but it can't be helped. 
Machan gave it her all.
choice_data_list:
My dream of becoming the official URA 
mascot is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating, yes, but I've already 
sorted through those feelings.
choice_data_list:
What about the dream of being an Ultra 
Super Mascot!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Because Machan believes in you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It means that as long as you are here, 
Aston Machan will never disappear.

Come to think of it, she had said 
something like that before.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, as long as you are here, 
Ma-chan will not disappear.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So, everything is quite all right.

It was a relieved smile. It almost felt as 
though that sense of relief had pushed her 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please tell everyone about Chan, 
Trainer-san.

The words left my mouth before I could 
even think.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list:
I don't want to do this without you 
either.
I don't want to do it without you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: This is where Aston Machan begins.

This is where Aston Machan begins, you 
know!

text_block_list.text:
Not anyone else— Not Vodka, and not Daiwa 
Scarlet.

Aston Machan blazes across the turf. The 
stands buzz with anticipation, hearts 
pounding with excitement.

Kicking up the dirt again and again, 
streaking across the turf in the blink of 
an eye—
Again and again, they let us dream.

It will keep shining brightly forever and 
ever.
choice_data_list: That's how it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ………… From... here.

Aston Machan fell silent. She seemed 
unsure of what to do. The silence lingered 
between them for a whileâ

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

They casually leaned in and peered into my 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It is still recording, I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I see it's still reflected in your eyes. 
The sparkling, dazzling Chan-me."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And that it is still not enough.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's how it is. Then that 
means—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...We have a problem.

"And so, Aston Machan turned her back to 
the sea."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan will ignore it. Ma-chan will 
pretend not to hear the calling voice."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. My Trainer is just a 
weird person, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Head to the river mouth, then go from 
downstream to upstream.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...The water might rush in, and unable to 
fight the current, we could get pushed 
right back into the sea."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A hole might open in the hull, and the 
mast might snap. Even so—even then.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The legend of Ma-chan isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Shall we just agree on that, then?"
